label: Teltonika TRM250
description: An industrial USB modem for LTE Cat M1, NB-IoT and EGPRS: a USB stick in a rugged case with an external antenna connector. No Ethernet, no serial, no radio - the host provides all of that.
notes: Vendor figures from the TRM250 datasheet: a USB interface plus an external antenna connector; LTE Cat M1 / NB-IoT / EGPRS. The cellular interface is modelled at 1M because Cat M1 tops out around 1 Mbps. There is no Ethernet or serial port on this device, and the catalogue has no interface type for USB, so the modem's only modelled interface is its cellular one - the missing USB is a modelling boundary, not a claim that the device has no connector.
